title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
preconditions: User is registered with email 'user@example.com' and password 'SecurePass123'.
expected_result: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Unsuccessful Login with Invalid Password
expected_result: An error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed, and the user remains on the login page.

title: Validation Warning for Empty Fields
preconditions: User is on the login page.
steps: Leave both email and password fields empty.
expected_result: Validation warnings are displayed for both the email and password fields indicating they are required.

title: Validation Warning for Empty Password Field
preconditions: User is on the login page.
expected_result: A validation warning is displayed for the password field indicating it is required.

title: Account Locking After Three Failed Attempts
steps: Enter 'user@example.com' and an incorrect password, then click 'Login' (Attempt 1).
Enter 'user@example.com' and an incorrect password, then click 'Login' (Attempt 2).
Enter 'user@example.com' and an incorrect password, then click 'Login' (Attempt 3).
expected_result: An account locked message is displayed, and the account is locked from further login attempts.

title: No Account Lock on Two Failed Attempts Followed by Success
preconditions: User is registered with email 'user@example.com' and password 'SecurePass123'.
steps: Enter 'user@example.com' and an incorrect password, then click 'Login' (Attempt 1).
Enter 'user@example.com' and an incorrect password, then click 'Login' (Attempt 2).
Enter 'user@example.com' and the correct password 'SecurePass123', then click 'Login'.
expected_result: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard without the account being locked.
